name: code-graph-view
description: Explore code as an interactive call graph: trace callers and callees, see what a git change affects, and curate compact context for AI assistants.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runs git in the workspace and reads its history; a repository you don't trust can run programs through its git configuration.

codeGraphView.maxDepth.description: Call hops to fetch upfront, upward (callers) and downward (callees). Lower is faster; clicking a method fetches its full chain on demand.

codeGraphView.hideTests.description: Leave test files (*.spec.ts, *.test.ts, __tests__) out of the graph unless one is the root.

codeGraphView.includeConstructors.description: Include constructors as graph nodes. Off by default because dependency-injection constructors add a lot of noise.

codeGraphView.redactSecrets.description: Replace credentials (API keys, tokens, private keys, passwords in URLs and quoted secrets) with [REDACTED] in the AI context you copy or send. Leave on unless you have a reason not to.
